title: •_Slave I_
caption: •_Slave I_ (V)
game_text: May add 1 alien pilot and 3 passengers. May deploy with non-{maintenance} Boba Fett as a react (for free). While Boba Fett piloting, maneuver +2, power may not be reduced, and immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Originally designed as a planetary defense craft. Uses restricted jamming technology, allowing it to appear out of nowhere. Contains many hidden armaments.

notes: Unique. 'Slave I' italic in the slip's heading and caption ('(V)' upright), marked _…_ as vs5/46; 'Boba Fett' in the game text is not italic. Banner STARFIGHTER: FIRESPRAY-CLASS ATTACK SHIP. Stats POWER 4 / MANEUVER 4 / HYPERSPEED 4; deploy 3 / forfeit 5 (printed 5 / 4). Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: independent (blue wheel), nav (red square, green dome). Inline icon in 'non-[gold spoked wheel] Boba Fett' → {maintenance} per this run's instructions (the stub reads it as '[permanent pilot]' — stub differs). Lore matches the scan. Base scan 350 px only; copyright line legible: 1997 (Cloud City). Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded). V1-D-slaveisymboloffear.gif is a different card (Slave I, Symbol Of Fear).
